changelog: New VENMO balance tile next to the bank tiles (shows a dash until a Venmo balance is in balances.json)
Balance, PAYPAL and CASHFLOW tiles are about 30% narrower
CASH FLOW tile shows money out over the last 7 days; tap it for a scrollable withdrawal history with an account filter
Blue CASHFLOW buttons on timeline days with withdrawals open that day's list
Day labels can use a 5th line when there is room; Privacy Blur covers the new tile and panel
Timeline: bill labels stay below the PAYDAY and month tags at any strip height, compacting the stack on shorter strips
Timeline: bill labels are now a 4-line stack: name, how often it repeats, the account it pays from, then the amount due
Timeline: TODAY now always lands on the current local day; the app opens on today, scrolling snaps to whole days, and the day rolls over at local midnight
Timeline: each bill label is now a 3-line stack: name, short info line, then amount due
Timeline: the TODAY line now stops just above the day-of-week labels instead of covering them
Logo: MONEY and LINE no longer cut off; letters now have a brushed, scratched gunmetal texture with the thin white outline
Bottom bar: removed the small eye privacy icon; the PRIVACY BLUR button is now the only blur control (auto re-blur still works)
Logo: MONEY / LINE now in gunmetal gray Impact with a thin white outline (no green glow); green EKG heartbeat unchanged
Bottom bar: removed the ON-TIME STREAK readout
Bottom bar: new credit card balance tiles (PLATINUM, SECURED, SAVOR, PAYPAL) right of SCHWAB, read from your local balances file only
Privacy Blur now also covers the card tiles
